---
title: "setNamesSGP()"
subtitle: "Function for renaming data (typically from outputSGP) from a state/organization naming conventions to those used in the SGP package"
toc: true
---

## Description

setNamesSGP renames a dataset (without copying or returning the data).

## Usage

``` R
setNamesSGP(
    data,
    state=NULL)
```

## Arguments

`data`{#data}

:   The dataset to be renamed. For example longitudinal data exported from [`outputSGP`](outputSGP.html) that uses a state's naming conventions.

`state`{#state}

:   The 'state' for the `data` Derive from `data` name if not explicitly supplied.

## Value

NULL. Simply renames the data. Note that the `state` must be included in the `SGPstateData` and have a `Variable_Name_Lookup` entry to work.

## Author(s)

Adam R. Van Iwaarden <avaniwaarden@nciea.org>

[`outputSGP`](outputSGP.html)

## Examples

``` R
## Not run: 
load("Data/Demonstration_SGP_LONG_Data.Rdata")
setNamesSGP(Demonstration_SGP_LONG_Data)

## End(Not run)
```
